customMemoryType.name: organizational_state_projection
customMemoryType.description: A deterministic current-state projection derived from immutable organizational-state observations.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Projection contract version; always organizational-state-projection-v1.

fields.name: state_id
fields.description: Canonical state-family identifier selected by the versioned resolution policy.

fields.name: state_kind
fields.description: Current controlled organizational-state kind.

fields.name: lifecycle_status
fields.description: Current lifecycle after deterministic projection.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Current source-grounded state statement.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Canonical Project identifier.

fields.name: project_step_id
fields.description: Canonical Project Step identifier when grounded.

fields.name: meeting_id
fields.description: Canonical Meeting identifier for the current observation when grounded.

fields.name: accountable_entity_id
fields.description: Canonical accountable Employee or Team identifier when grounded.

fields.name: related_entity_ids
fields.description: Other canonical entity identifiers explicitly involved.

fields.name: valid_at
fields.description: Source-provided event date or publication time for the projected state.

fields.name: event_sequence
fields.description: Deterministic source-event order used when valid_at is shared.

fields.name: source_offset_ms
fields.description: Transcript-relative start offset used within one event; zero when unavailable.

fields.name: due_at
fields.description: Grounded due time, when present.

fields.name: resolved_at
fields.description: Grounded resolution time, when present.

fields.name: requested_decision
fields.description: Explicit management decision requested by the current observation.

fields.name: impact
fields.description: Explicit material consequence recorded by the current observation.

fields.name: conflict_status
fields.description: Controlled projection conflict status: none or unresolved.

fields.name: supporting_memory_ids
fields.description: Immutable observation memory IDs supporting this projection.

fields.name: conflicting_memory_ids
fields.description: Observation memory IDs that remain unresolved at the projection frontier.

fields.name: observation_count
fields.description: Number of current-revision observations considered for this state family.

fields.name: current_memory_id
fields.description: Immutable observation memory ID selected as the current source state.

fields.name: resolution_policy_id
fields.description: Versioned policy that mapped observations to this state family.

extractionStrategy.prompt: Current-state projections are built deterministically after document extraction.
